### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s).

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 52ff308b8686f1f5a304341534bd8b8eb1cdd59e`.

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **143** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 52ff308b8686f1f5a304341534bd8b8eb1cdd59e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5f9defbc20ab2ee3ae5602850daecf20879af165` — the merge of head `1c3722ca1a622f63c566c58903bf137150b956bc` into base `52ff308b8686f1f5a304341534bd8b8eb1cdd59e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5f9defbc20ab2ee3ae5602850daecf20879af165 && git checkout 5f9defbc20ab2ee3ae5602850daecf20879af165
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 52ff308b8686f1f5a304341534bd8b8eb1cdd59e 1c3722ca1a622f63c566c58903bf137150b956bc && git checkout -B drift-repro 52ff308b8686f1f5a304341534bd8b8eb1cdd59e && git merge --no-ff 1c3722ca1a622f63c566c58903bf137150b956bc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 52ff308b8686f1f5a304341534bd8b8eb1cdd59e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 52ff308b8686f1f5a304341534bd8b8eb1cdd59e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1c3722ca1a622f63c566c58903bf137150b956bc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts + packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization-rename-action.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/platform-objects.test.ts, .changeset/24271-org-rename-door.md; read unchanged at the head for the claims those hunks make: packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.test.ts, packages/spec/api-surface/kernel.json, packages/spec/export-origins/kernel.json, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts (beforeUpdateOrganization, :3607), packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization-invite-action.test.ts, docs/adr/0133-org-management-open-basics.md, docs/adr/0093-tenancy-mode-and-membership-lifecycle.md (D8), .github/workflows/ci.yml (dogfood job `if:`). The other five paths of the diff (four `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles, packages/qa/dogfood/test/organization-rename-door.dogfood.test.ts) are the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Inputs: card #24271 (body and all six comments, 6248084492 through 6249653353), PR #24317 (body, ten-path file list, net diff `origin/main...1c3722ca1`), and the 41 check-runs on the head, all `completed`: every non-skipped run `success` (Test Core and its six shards, Build Core, Lint & Repo Gates and its nine lanes, Type Check lanes, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec property liveness, the queue and claim guards); the skipped ones are the dogfood shards, Dogfood Verify CLI, Console Pin Gate, Temporal Conformance, Build Docs and the opt-in tarball smoke. Reviewed with no worktree, build, test or gate run; the record was written 2026-10-18T12:26Z.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The face's one hunk, right.** `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts` gains `'sys_organization.actions.rename_organization'` in `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs` (between `update_organization` and `delete_organization`) and two comment lines; nothing else in the file moves. No key on `PublicAuthFeatureEntry`, no new flag (`PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURE_NAMES` stays at 11, pinned by `public-auth-features.test.ts:20`), no new `requiresFeature` enum value, no new export (`api-surface/kernel.json` and `export-origins/kernel.json` list `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES (const)` by name only, and neither is in the diff). The path follows the registry grammar the spec test and the guard both parse (object dot `actions` dot action).

2. **The rule and its gate land as one change, right.** `packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts` is unchanged on this head and reads the pair in both directions. Forward: the booked path resolves to the object's `rename_organization`, whose only visibility is `requiresFeature: 'multiOrgEnabled'`, lowered by `lowerRequiresFeature` to exactly `features.multiOrgEnabled != false` (pinned by the rename-action test, "is gated on multiOrgEnabled, the same lowered predicate as update_organization", and by the lowering-matrix row added to `platform-objects.test.ts:589`). Reverse: that predicate references `features.multiOrgEnabled`, and the new row books it; the walker floor (37 or more references) only rises. The card records the reverse direction red without the row (dev probe 6248699001 on `8bfb17d47`), which is what the guard's code says it would do. Both directions ran in CI on this head: Test Core shards 1 through 6, `success`.

3. **The flag chosen, right.** The rename books under `multiOrgEnabled`, not `organization`. ADR-0093 D8 keeps `features.organization` (member management) and `features.multiOrgEnabled` (organization management) apart, and ADR-0133 records that organization lifecycle actions sit under `multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs`. A name/logo rename is organization management and mirrors `update_organization`'s row, so on a single-organization boot it hides with every sibling organization action (the dev's stock-boot reading: `/auth/config` serves `multiOrgEnabled: false`).

4. **What the row makes a claim about, verified in the object.** `sys-organization.object.ts` at the head declares `rename_organization`: `type: 'api'`, target `/api/v1/auth/organization/update`, `recordIdParam: 'organizationId'`, `bodyShape: { wrap: 'data' }`, `locations: ['record_header', 'list_item']`, `mode: 'edit'`, `variant: 'secondary'`, `requiresFeature: 'multiOrgEnabled'`, params exactly `name` (required, `defaultFromRow`) and `logo` (`defaultFromRow`), no `slug`. The diff's only other hunks in that file are comments; `update_organization` (name, slug, logo; `list_item`) and `change_slug` (cloud orchestrator target; `record_header`; one `slug` param) are byte-unchanged, and the new pin's two control tests say so.

5. **The ruled header order holds by reading.** Stable sort by `order` (unset = 0) over the five `record_header` actions in declaration order gives `invite_user` (-1), `set_active_organization` (0), `rename_organization` (0), `change_slug` (0), `leave_organization` (1): the inline row is invite, set active, rename; `change_slug` and `leave_organization` fold into the overflow, as the amended claim (6248721024) ruled. The older invite pin (`sys-organization-invite-action.test.ts:77-90`: invite first, leave at index 3 or later, more than three header actions) still holds with five.

6. **The slug claim in the object's comment, verified at its real path.** `beforeUpdateOrganization` lives at `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:3607` (the PR body's `auth-manager.ts:3607` drops the `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/` prefix; the line is right) and returns at once when `organization.slug` is falsy, so a body with no `slug` key never reaches the slug guard. The booted reading of that same fact is the dev's, not a check-run (see ③ 6).

7. **Accept sets and public surface, net.** `@objectstack/spec`: no accept set changes; an exported constant's value gains one string. `@objectstack/platform-objects`: `SysOrganization` gains one named action, a published object the runtime registers and the console renders, and four translation bundles gain its two leaves (tool-regenerated, `check:i18n` inside Lint & Repo Gates, `success`). No docs page at the head enumerates `sys_organization`'s header actions or the `multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs` list (`git grep` over `content/docs` and `docs/`: none), so no page is owed.

8. **Face and tier.** `reviewFace` over the PR's ten paths answers the schema face with `hits.schema = [packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts]` and no governed-register hit, so the tier is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` and this record's `Scope:` floor is that one path.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/24271-org-rename-door.md`: `@objectstack/platform-objects: minor`, `@objectstack/spec: patch`, and `Clause-②: yes` as the last line; the PR body carries the same `Clause-②: yes`. Not `skip-changeset`. Check Changeset on the head: `success`.
- **`yes` is right.** The widening act is the new action name on a published platform object, served at runtime: an additive widening of `@objectstack/platform-objects`' public surface, which pr-automation's WHICH LEVEL rule and `check-changeset-no-major` grade at least `minor` on the package that grew. `minor` sits on that package.
- **spec `patch` is right.** The row adds no exported symbol, no accepted key and no accepted value (`requiresFeature`'s enum is untouched, no schema moves), so nothing WHICH LEVEL names fires for `@objectstack/spec`; its only type effect is the literal union of `multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs` growing, which has no consumer in this repo beyond the two guards and none in the objectui checkout. Precedent: `b0a1df044` (#24216) booked `sys_organization.actions.invite_user` the same way with spec `patch` (its changeset `.changeset/24016-org-invite-action.md` is still at the head), and the CHANGELOG precedent for the `set_user_role` row calls the row "internal completeness-guard bookkeeping only, no public export shape change".
- Noted, not re-judged: #24216 declared `Clause-②: no` with platform-objects `patch` for the same kind of act (a new action on `sys_organization`). This PR's `yes` plus `minor` is the reading the rule supports; the precedent is landed history.
- Nothing is removed or renamed, so no BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 disposition is owed; `check-adr-0087-registration` ran inside Lint & Repo Gates, `success`.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's final report (6249492189) has `open_questions: []`; its eight deviations and three out-of-scope findings, answered or escalated:

1. **Hand-written zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES values in the generated bundles.** Within AGENTS.md's `**/translations/*.generated.ts` row: structure by the tool, translated-locale values hand-written. Both extracts were the tool's, the keys match `en`'s, `check:i18n` is green. Answered.
2. **The actions block's header comment restated.** It sits directly above `actions:` and the change made it false; inside the claim's "actions block only" surface. Answered.
3. **`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally.** Run by Lint & Repo Gates ("Every published require entry point actually loads"), `success` on the head. Answered.
4. **Temporary measurement test file.** Not among the ten paths. Answered.
5. **Commit trailers.** Both commits (`326f79774`, `1c3722ca1`) carry AGENTS.md's model-free `Claude-Session` plus `Co-authored-by` pair; no model identifier in the PR body, changeset or diff. Answered.
6. **The booted pin has no check-run on this head.** `ci.yml`'s `dogfood` job skips on `pull_request` and `merge_group` (its `if:`), and Test Core excludes `@objectstack/dogfood`, so `organization-rename-door.dogfood.test.ts` rests on the dev's local 2 of 2 and its dist-via-cache-hit reasoning; its first CI run is the post-merge push or the scheduled battery. The contract face does not depend on it (the guard and the declaration pin ran in Test Core). **Escalated to the lane seat as a known CI-unmeasured pin:** a red on it in the first full battery is this PR's to own.
7. **Only the declaration pin was ablated.** Accepted; the booted pin's ablation would need a rebuild the read-only shape forbids here too.
8. **Aborted spec run.** Nothing from it is cited. Answered.
9. **Out of scope, `change_slug` 404 on an open-source multi-organization boot.** Filed as #24318 (open, `domain:engine`, `pm:queue`). Answered; after this PR the dead door sits in the overflow, not inline.
10. **Out of scope, the API-level slug door through `organization/update` with `data.slug` on a cloud composition.** Carried by objectstack-ai/cloud#3000 per the dev; outside this repo and not readable here. Noted.
11. **Out of scope, comment drift at `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-organization.page.ts:15`** ("Set Active, Edit, Delete, Leave" as the header actions). Verified stale: Edit and Delete are `list_item` only, and the header now carries invite, set active, rename, change slug, leave. Carrier none. **Escalated to the lane seat:** fold it into #24318's touch of the same object, or a docs-only PR; not this PR's surface.
12. **Lane routing (triage note 6249653353).** `packages/platform-objects` is `domain:engine`'s; the card ran under `domain:services` and the label stays until the dev is done. Process, not contract; the landing note names the lane.
13. **Admin-grade rename.** The dev's P3 for `admin` is a source reading (better-auth `access/statement.mjs`), not a boot. Not a contract matter; noted.
